extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and contributors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who find a 'page does not exist' message and want to create, locate, or request a new Wikipedia article. Covers account requirements, searching for existing content, redirects, and troubleshooting visibility/deletion issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for Patrice O'Neal death in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for "Patrice O'Neal death" in existing articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use "What links here" / backlink tools to find related pages and determine if a redirect or existing coverage already exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status required to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed, use alternative workflows (drafts, requests) rather than trying to create the article directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a live article (e.g., due to account status or deletion concerns), submit a draft via the article wizard or request creation so it can be reviewed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page visibility delay / try purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before recreating a page, check again after a short wait and use the purge function to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (except first character); consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create a redirect from the variant to the canonical article title instead of creating a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page may have been removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion-log entries and associated explanations before attempting to recreate content; follow guidance shown in deletion notices or help pages.
